1 // judge.mjs — Crucible's model-side DECIDER of convergence (Wave 3).
2 //
3 // The Judge is the model-side decider (the human is the final authority; the
4 // Synthesizer DIRECTS but never decides — see bin/synthesizer.mjs). It runs as a
5 // FRESH, CONTEXT-FREE sub-agent with ALL the evidence placed in its prompt — the
6 // round's surviving findings, the North Star, the per-wave acceptance criteria,
7 // and (when present) the fresh-eyes cold pass. It never reads the anchored
8 // Synthesizer's direction log, so it cannot inherit the Director's position.
9 //
10 // Two modes (MASTER-PLAN §10):
11 //   - Default (subscription-only): a SAME-MODEL judge persona run as a fresh,
12 //     context-free sub-agent through the Wave-1 `agent` seam.
13 //   - Enhanced (a different model family is reachable): a CROSS-MODEL judge — the
14 //     strongest model from a family OTHER than the plan's author. Wave 3 builds the
15 //     selection + the per-role STAMP and routes both paths through the injected
16 //     `agent` seam; Wave 9 binds the real cross-model CLIs to the probe.
17 //
18 // Either way the run STAMPS which model filled the Judge role, so a plan's
19 // provenance shows exactly how much cross-model independence it actually got.
20 
21 import { HaltError } from './crucible-lib.mjs';
22 import { makeReliableAgent } from '../../drivers/reliability.mjs';
23 
24 export const JUDGE_ROLE = 'Judge';
25 
26 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
27 // Per-role model stamp (shared by the Judge and the Synthesizer).
28 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
29 
30 /**
31  * The provenance stamp for one role: which model/family filled it, under which
32  * substrate mode, and whether that was genuine cross-model independence. Both the
33  * Judge and the Synthesizer stamp themselves with this so every run records who
34  * filled which role (MASTER-PLAN §10 "stamp which model filled which role").
35  *
36  * @param {object} o
37  * @param {string}  o.role                  e.g. 'Judge' | 'Synthesizer'
38  * @param {string} [o.model='claude']       the concrete model that ran the role
39  * @param {string} [o.family='claude']      its model family
40  * @param {string} [o.mode='default']       'default' | 'enhanced'
41  * @param {boolean}[o.reachable=false]      was a different-family model reachable?
42  * @returns {{role:string,model:string,family:string,mode:string,cross_model:boolean}}
43  */
44 export function stampRole({ role, model = 'claude', family = 'claude', mode = 'default', reachable = false } = {}) {
45   if (!role) {
46     throw new HaltError('stampRole requires a role', 'pass { role: "Judge" | "Synthesizer" | ... }');
47   }
48   return {
49     role,
50     model,
51     family,
52     mode,
53     // Genuine cross-model independence only when Enhanced mode actually reached a
54     // different family — Default mode (same-model persona) is never cross-model.
55     cross_model: mode === 'enhanced' && !!reachable,
56   };
57 }
58 
59 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
60 // Judge-model selection (Default vs Enhanced).
61 //
62 // Wave 3 establishes the contract + stamp; the probe is INJECTABLE so Wave 9 can
63 // bind the real Gemini/GPT/Grok CLIs. The default probe returns null => Default
64 // mode, exactly like Foreman on the bare subscription.
65 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
66 
67 /** Default capability probe: nothing reachable ⇒ Default (same-model) mode. */
68 export function defaultProbeCrossModel() {
69   return null;
70 }
71 
72 /**
73  * Pick the Judge's model. Enhanced when the probe surfaces a model from a family
74  * OTHER than the plan's author (the highest-leverage place to break same-family
75  * self-preference); otherwise the same-model judge persona (Default mode).
76  *
77  * @param {object} o
78  * @param {string}   [o.authorFamily='claude']            the family that AUTHORED the plan
79  * @param {Function} [o.probe=defaultProbeCrossModel]     ()=> ({model,family}) | null
80  * @returns {{model:string,family:string,mode:string,reachable:boolean}}
81  */
82 export function selectJudgeModel({ authorFamily = 'claude', probe = defaultProbeCrossModel } = {}) {
83   const reachable = typeof probe === 'function' ? probe() : null;
84   if (reachable && reachable.family && reachable.family !== authorFamily) {
85     // Enhanced: a genuinely different family decides at the lock gate.
86     return { model: reachable.model || reachable.family, family: reachable.family, mode: 'enhanced', reachable: true };
87   }
88   // Default: a same-model judge persona, run fresh + context-free.
89   return { model: authorFamily, family: authorFamily, mode: 'default', reachable: false };
90 }
91 
92 /**
93  * T7 (2026-07-11): derive the Judge's selection from the run's ROLE ROUTES — the
94  * ground truth of where the judge role's calls actually dispatch. When a role-routed
95  * agent sends `role:'judge'` to a non-author family (the DEFAULT_CRUCIBLE_ROUTES
96  * shape: judge → gemini-cli), the stamp is honestly `enhanced`/cross_model — the old
97  * default probe returned null and UNDERSTATED a genuinely cross-family run as a
98  * same-model persona (and the observed live pathology was the inverse: the default
99  * Claude substrate judging its own family's plan across 4 held dry rounds).
100  *
101  * @param {object} o
102  * @param {?object} [o.routes=null]         role → { driver, model } (judge ?? default)
103  * @param {string}  [o.authorFamily='claude']
104  * @returns {{model:string,family:string,mode:string,reachable:boolean}}
105  */
106 export function selectJudgeFromRoutes({ routes = null, authorFamily = 'claude' } = {}) {
107   const r = routes && (routes.judge ?? routes.default);
108   const drv = r && r.driver ? String(r.driver).trim().toLowerCase() : null;
109   const family = !drv ? null
110     : drv.startsWith('gemini') ? 'gemini'
111     : drv.startsWith('claude') ? 'claude'
112     : drv.split(/[-\s]/)[0] || null;
113   if (family && family !== authorFamily) {
114     return { model: (r.model || r.driver), family, mode: 'enhanced', reachable: true };
115   }
116   return { model: authorFamily, family: authorFamily, mode: 'default', reachable: false };
117 }

119 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
120 // The Judge's decision schema + its context-free prompt.
121 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
122 
123 /** The Judge's reply: a binding verdict (it DECIDES — this is not advisory). */
124 export const JUDGE_SCHEMA = {
125   type: 'object',
126   required: ['decision'],
127   properties: {
128     decision: { enum: ['CONVERGED', 'NOT_CONVERGED', 'CHALLENGE'] },
129     reasons: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },
130     blocking: {
131       type: 'array',
132       items: {
133         type: 'object',
134         properties: { id: { type: 'string' }, severity: { type: 'string' }, note: { type: 'string' } },
135       },
136     },
137   },
138 };
139 
140 function judgePrompt({ northStar, findings, acceptanceCriteria, freshEyes }) {
141   return [
142     `You are the JUDGE — the model-side DECIDER of convergence — running in a FRESH,`,
143     `CONTEXT-FREE sub-agent. You have NO prior context: no memory of any prior round and`,
144     `no access to any Director's direction log. Decide ONLY from the evidence below.`,
145     ``,
146     `=== THE NORTH STAR (verbatim) ===`,
147     String(northStar ?? '(none provided)'),
148     `=== END NORTH STAR ===`,
149     ``,
150     `=== SURVIVING FINDINGS (the round's tallied, non-demoted findings) ===`,
151     findings.length
152       ? findings.map((f, i) => `(${i + 1}) [${f.severity || '?'}] ${f.message || f.id || JSON.stringify(f)}`).join('\n')
153       : '(none — the round is clean)',
154     `=== END FINDINGS ===`,
155     ``,
156     `=== PER-WAVE ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===`,
157     acceptanceCriteria.length ? acceptanceCriteria.map((c, i) => `(${i + 1}) ${c}`).join('\n') : '(none provided)',
158     `=== END ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===`,
159     freshEyes
160       ? `\n=== FRESH-EYES COLD PASS ===\nlean=${freshEyes.lean}; ${freshEyes.note || ''}\n=== END FRESH-EYES ===\n`
161       : '',
162     ``,
163     `DECIDE:`,
164     `  - CONVERGED only if there is NO open BLOCKER/MAJOR, the round is dry, and the`,
165     `    fresh-eyes pass raises no material divergence.`,
166     `  - CHALLENGE if the fresh-eyes pass materially diverges and one more adversarial`,
167     `    round is warranted before any lock.`,
168     `  - otherwise NOT_CONVERGED.`,
169   ].join('\n');
170 }

172 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
173 // The Judge.
174 // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
175 
176 /**
177  * Build the Judge from the injected Wave-1 `agent` seam. The Judge holds NO
178  * reference to the Synthesizer — its only inputs are the evidence handed to
179  * `decide()`, keeping it genuinely context-free.
180  *
181  * @param {object} o
182  * @param {Function}  o.agent                                the Wave-1 agent seam
183  * @param {string}   [o.authorFamily='claude']               family that authored the plan
184  * @param {Function} [o.probeCrossModel=defaultProbeCrossModel]
185  * @param {Function} [o.log=()=>{}]
186  */
187 export function makeJudge({ agent, authorFamily = 'claude', probeCrossModel = defaultProbeCrossModel, routes = null, log = () => {} } = {}) {
188   if (typeof agent !== 'function') {
189     throw new HaltError(
190       'makeJudge requires an agent() function',
191       'pass the Wave-1 seam: makeJudge({ agent: makeAgentSeam(...).agent })',
192     );
193   }
194   // Wave 1: the injected seam is reliability-wrapped HERE, at its injection point,
195   // so the Judge's adjudication call inherits typed retry + round-aware idempotency.
196   // Transparent on the success path (one inner call, opts unchanged).
197   const reliableAgent = makeReliableAgent({ agent });
198   // T7: routes (where the judge role ACTUALLY dispatches) beat the probe when supplied.
199   const selection = routes
200     ? selectJudgeFromRoutes({ routes, authorFamily })
201     : selectJudgeModel({ authorFamily, probe: probeCrossModel });
202   const stamp = stampRole({ role: JUDGE_ROLE, model: selection.model, family: selection.family, mode: selection.mode, reachable: selection.reachable });
203 
204   return {
205     selection,
206     stamp,
207 
208     /**
209      * DECIDE convergence from the injected evidence (and nothing else). Returns a
210      * binding verdict carrying the model stamp. An abstain/unparseable judge reply
211      * cannot silently pass — the Judge synthesizes a HALT for human review instead.
212      *
213      * @param {object} o
214      * @param {string}   o.northStar
215      * @param {object[]}[o.findings=[]]             the round's surviving (non-demoted) findings
216      * @param {string[]}[o.acceptanceCriteria=[]]   the per-wave oracle
217      * @param {?object} [o.freshEyes=null]          the fresh-eyes cold-pass assessment
218      * @param {number}  [o.round=0]
219      */
220     async decide({ northStar, findings = [], acceptanceCriteria = [], freshEyes = null, round = 0 } = {}) {
221       const prompt = judgePrompt({ northStar, findings, acceptanceCriteria, freshEyes });
222       const out = await reliableAgent(prompt, { label: `judge:r${round}:${selection.model}`, schema: JUDGE_SCHEMA, role: 'judge', round });
223 
224       // The Judge MUST decide. An abstain (answerable:no) or a reply without a
225       // decision cannot be read as a silent pass — escalate to the human.
226       const decision = out?.decision;
227       if (!decision || out?.answerable === 'no') {
228         log(`judge r${round}: no decision from the sub-agent — HALT for human review`);
229         return {
230           decision: 'HALT',
231           lockable: false,
232           halted: true,
233           reasons: ['judge sub-agent could not produce a decision after retry — HALT for human review'],
234           blocking: [],
235           stamp,
236           promptSent: prompt,
237         };
238       }
239 
240       const verdict = {
241         decision,
242         lockable: decision === 'CONVERGED',
243         reasons: Array.isArray(out.reasons) ? out.reasons : [],
244         blocking: Array.isArray(out.blocking) ? out.blocking : [],
245         stamp,
246         promptSent: prompt,
247       };
248       log(`judge r${round}: ${decision} (${stamp.cross_model ? `cross-model: ${stamp.model}` : `same-model persona: ${stamp.model}`})`);
249       return verdict;
250     },
251   };
252 }
